title: Scout from M’Soft is the agentic Autopilot that works across M365
summary: Microsoft announced at Build event a new agentic 'Autopilot' feature called Scout that operates autonomously across Microsoft 365 applications. Each Autopilot has its own identity, allowing multiple AI agents to work on a user's behalf across different M365 services.
problem_solved: Enables users to delegate complex multi-app tasks to autonomous AI agents that can work across Microsoft 365 without constant human oversight.
why_valuable: Revolutionizes workplace productivity by providing AI agents with persistent identities that can autonomously navigate and complete tasks across the entire Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
